facts.finding: Invoice period_start/end concern accumulated invoice items and look back one period; provider explicitly directs service-period consumers to invoice lines.
Basil recurring parent exposes proration, subscription and subscription_item IDs.
Line period contains start/end timestamps described as inclusive; exact cadence boundary mapping still needs supported provider fixture evidence.

Embedded invoice lines can be only the first portion; use full GET /v1/invoices/:id/lines and prove traversal complete.
